Loan or debt facility agreement with the lending institution

NGO registration and track record documents

HSN classification details of the exported product

Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) registration of the cluster

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, National Health Mission
benefit: Free fixed-day antenatal care package, specialist doctor check-up, blood and urine tests, one ultrasound and medicines, for all pregnant women in their 2nd or 3rd trimester, offered on the 9th of every month at designated government health facilities.
documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card, if available
official_note: Available universally regardless of income; high-risk pregnancies identified during the check-up are specifically flagged for extra follow-up visits, and if the 9th falls on a Sunday or holiday, services shift to the next working day at most facilities.

name: Scholarship for Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Full financial support for graduate or postgraduate study at listed Institutes of Excellence: tuition reimbursement up to ₹1.9 lakh per year, maintenance allowance of ₹3,000 per month for hostellers or ₹1,500 per month for day scholars, plus book, special-needs and a one-time computer/assistive-aid grant.

Admission or current fee receipt from a listed Institute of Excellence

exclusions: Distance education, part-time and weekend courses are not covered

name: National Fellowship for Persons with Disabilities (NFPwD)
authority: University Grants Commission (UGC), on behalf of the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Monthly fellowship of ₹31,000 (Junior Research Fellow, first two years) rising to ₹35,000 (Senior Research Fellow) for full-time M.Phil./Ph.D. scholars with disabilities, plus contingency grants, house rent allowance, and a ₹2,000 per month reader/escort allowance for candidates with visual or physical disabilities.

Postgraduate mark sheet showing at least 50% marks
Proof of enrollment in a full-time regular M.Phil./Ph.D. programme

name: Accessible India Campaign (Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan)
authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Funds accessibility retrofits, ramps, lifts, accessible toilets and tactile signage, at public buildings, transport and government websites, and lets any person with a disability report an inaccessible public place through the Sugamya Bharat mobile app for redressal.
documents: None required to report an inaccessible site through the app
Disability certificate or UDID only if applying regarding a specific retrofit request
official_note: This is an infrastructure and enforcement campaign, not a direct cash or device benefit; results depend on the concerned building, transport or website owner acting on flagged accessibility complaints, so progress varies significantly by state and city.

Coverage is limited to government and other public buildings, websites and transport already targeted under the campaign

name: Deendayal Divyangjan Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)
authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Free or subsidised early intervention, special education, therapy, counselling and vocational rehabilitation services for persons with disabilities, delivered through Central Government-funded NGO-run special schools, early intervention centres and rehabilitation projects across India.

Enrollment through the local DDRS-funded NGO or rehabilitation centre

Not a cash-transfer scheme; support is delivered as in-kind services rather than direct payments

name: Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995 (EPS-95)

name: Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme (EDLI)
authority: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour and Employment
benefit: Pays a lump-sum insurance benefit of up to ₹7,00,000 (minimum ₹2,50,000) to the nominee or family of an EPF member who dies while in service, based on the member's average PF balance and salary.
official_note: The benefit applies only if death occurs while the employee is an active, contributing EPF member; the entire premium (0.5% of wages) is funded by the employer, so there is no cost to the employee.
exclusions: Not payable if the member had already left EPF service and was not an active contributor at the time of death
Coverage ceases once EPF membership lapses

name: NPS Vatsalya
authority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance
benefit: Lets parents or guardians open a pension account for a minor (below 18) with a minimum contribution of ₹250, building a long-term retirement corpus that converts into a regular NPS account in the minor's own name once they turn 18.
documents: Guardian's identity proof (Driving Licence/Passport/Voter ID/NREGA job card)
official_note: Partial withdrawals are capped at 25% of contributions (excluding investment returns) and are allowed only after a 3-year lock-in, mainly for the minor's education, medical treatment or disability.

name: National Pension System (NPS), All Citizen Model
authority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance
benefit: A voluntary, market-linked retirement savings account open to any Indian citizen aged 18 to 70, where contributions build a pension corpus that provides a lump sum plus a monthly annuity pension after age 60.
documents: KYC documents as prescribed in the NPS subscriber application form
official_note: At exit, at least 40% of the accumulated corpus must be used to buy an annuity for a regular pension, while the remaining amount can be withdrawn as a lump sum.
exclusions: Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs) and Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) are not eligible to subscribe
Cannot be opened jointly or operated on behalf of another person

name: Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Dependants' Benefit
authority: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour and Employment
benefit: Pays a monthly pension equal to 90% of the deceased insured person's average daily wage (minimum ₹1,200/month) to eligible family dependants when death occurs due to an employment injury or occupational disease, plus ₹15,000 for funeral expenses.
documents: Proof of relationship (marriage/birth certificate) for dependants
official_note: The widow receives the benefit for life or until remarriage, while dependent children receive it only until age 25; benefit applies from day one of insurable employment if death is due to an employment injury.

Only families of ESI-covered (insured) employees qualify

exclusions: Applies only to establishments covered under the EPF & MP Act, 1952 (factories/establishments with 20 or more employees, or as notified)
Full withdrawal before retirement is allowed only after two months of continuous unemployment

name: Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHC)

Application via ARHC portal or Urban Local Body

Recommendation or order of the Child Welfare Committee
